$comment: V50 Dwarf level-one reference choice maps and independently source-derived expectations. PREPARATION ONLY: no capture has been performed, no option is enabled, no expectation has been checked against any builder. Expectations are derived from the pinned Compendium, not from running Salient's evaluator.

pairedReference.role: Polder counterpart held constant except for ancestry

constantNotes: Holding Polder culture on a Dwarf is legal: ancestry 'doesn't grant you cultural benefits' (chapter/ancestries.md) and culture.language carries no dependsOn.
The Typical Ancestry Cultures table suggesting Zaliac for a dwarf is an optional archetype, not a grant.
Might is -1, which is the value the Stand Tough cases below depend on.
Reason is 2. Highest characteristic is 2 (Reason and Intuition).

expectationSources.stability: feature/trait/dwarf/grounded.md — +1 bonus to stability, over base 0
expectationSources.disengage: no-kit base 1; Polder's Graceful Retreat +1 is absent on a dwarf
expectationSources.potencyResistMight: feature/trait/dwarf/stand-tough.md — Might treated as 1 higher for resisting potencies only

expectationSources.conditionImmunities: feature/trait/dwarf/great-fortitude.md — you can't be made weakened; same shape as Polder Fearless/frightened

expectationSources.staminaMaximum: feature/trait/dwarf/spark-off-your-skin.md — +6 at level one, over the Elementalist base 18
expectationSources.recoveryValue: rule/health/recoveries.md — floor(24/3) = 8; must be recomputed, not cached
expectationSources.windedValue: rule/health/winded.md states 'half your Stamina maximum' with no rounding rule; 24 is even so 12 is exact. The floor convention used elsewhere is not exercised here.

standToughCases.$comment: Correctness cases for the scoped potency value. NOT discriminating: a global +1 to the Might characteristic yields the same comparison value 0 and therefore the same outcome at every band.
knownNonDiscriminating: Own weak/average/strong potency values: they derive from the highest characteristic score, which is 2 here, so Might -1 becoming 0 does not change them. The mightHighestRegression below closes this.

Might-based damage or power-roll expressions: the only ones in this build are the free strikes, which read 'M or A'; with Agility 1 the maximum is 1 whether Might is -1 or 0, so every tier is identical.

mightHighestRegression.$comment: Non-Forge evaluator regression that IS discriminating. Not a fourth capture.
mightHighestRegression.build: Dwarf + Berserker Fury 1 with Stand Tough
mightHighestRegression.characteristicsSource: tests/fixtures/v25-fury.json — an actual level-one Fury array

expected.ownPotencySource: rule/character/potency.md — derived from the highest characteristic score, which is 2

wrongImplementationWouldProduce.note: A global +1 makes Might strictly the highest at 3, shifting own potency. This is the assertion that fails.

scopeToMightCases.$comment: Nothing else establishes the +1 is scoped to Might rather than every characteristic. These use the constant selections directly.

traitAppliedContrast.$comment: Separates 'trait applied correctly' from 'trait always applied'.
traitAppliedContrast.note: Neither has Stand Tough, so both MUST be affected by M < 0.

edgeNotUnconditional.$comment: The edge applies only to Might tests called for to resist environmental effects or a creature's traits or abilities.
assertNoEdgeOn: a saving throw (d10 against 6, not a power roll)

illegalCases.expect: refused — interpretation, not a direct citation: no dwarf trait carries a repeat clause, and the pin's only explicitly repeatable trait (revenant Previous Life: 1 Point) says so in its text. The pin's sole stated prohibition is exceeding the budget.
illegalCases.label: interpretation

runicCarvingRunes.status: OUT OF LEVEL-ONE BUILD SCOPE — not a coverage gap
runicCarvingRunes.note: Recorded interpretation (see the slice document): a dwarf begins play with no rune active, and a level-one build with no rune is complete. The three rune options are therefore not level-one build options and need no counterparts. This is a SCOPE statement, not a claim that rune behaviour is verified: the runes, Detection's nested subtype, and carving, changing and removal all remain readable source with manual play resolution and no counterpart coverage.
runicCarvingRunes.referenceLimitIfEverTested: Forge does not model Detection's creature/object type — it is prose in the option description with no data field — so a Forge counterpart could carry 'Detection selected' but not 'goblins' as structured data.

unspentPoints.policy: Q-CHAR-10 — permit unspent points with a warning, no separate acknowledgement; overspending remains invalid

completionDetection.note: capture-v50-forge.ts cannot detect editor completion state; every witness is completionVerified: false and must be confirmed by hand before it counts as a counterpart.

forgeCorrections.$comment: character-verification.md requires source-backed Forge differences to carry a recorded explanation. The paired Bethell baseline needed three (see tests/fixtures/v25-bethell.json reference.corrections), so this is a live possibility, not a hypothetical.
forgeCorrections.note: If the pinned editor offers or records something the source does not permit, record it here and in counterparts.json rather than silently using the corrected value.
